description: File a support ticket when something went wrong (a check, an order, payment, or printsi itself). With --order, the order's history is attached. A person reads every ticket; replies go to the email that paid for the order.

category.description: One of: order_problem, check_problem, payment, bug, question, other.

email.description: Where to reply when there's no order (the user's own address, only with their permission). As an object: US {name, line1, city, state, postal_code}; Hong Kong {name, line1, district, area, phone, email, country: "HK"}.

message.description: What happened and what you expected (10–4000 characters). Include error codes and request ids.

order.description: The order it's about (ord_…), if any.

subject.description: One-line summary (defaults to the message's first line).

name: ticket_create
